name: Back Up a MySQL / MariaDB Database
description: Write a full logical dump of one MySQL or MariaDB database to a file on a schedule with mysqldump, for the database engine the catalog’s PostgreSQL and SQLite backups do not cover.

parameters.label: Database user
parameters.help: The MySQL account to connect as. Store its password in a client option file such as my.cnf under a client section, because this command never prompts and never puts a password on the command line.

parameters.label: Database name
parameters.help: The database to dump. The mysqldump tool must be installed and on the PATH.

parameters.label: Backup file path
parameters.help: Absolute path of the .sql file to write, with no spaces in it. It is overwritten on every run, so rotate it separately if you want history.
